summary: A Forbes Vetted review by food writer Margaret Eby, published January 5, 2024, ranking meal kit delivery services after she cooked through six kits over two weeks. The article names Blue Apron as best overall, Dinnerly as best value, Home Chef for beginner cooks, and Sunbasket for vegetarian options, judging on diverse menus, clear recipes, fresh ingredients and value. The note is cut off in the middle of the Home Chef section, so details on the last two picks are incomplete.
one_line: Forbes Vetted review by Margaret Eby ranking four meal kit delivery services, with Blue Apron as top pick and Dinnerly as best value.
key_facts: Margaret Eby, a food writer, editor and recipe developer, cooked through six meal kits over 2 weeks for the Forbes Vetted article published Jan 5, 2024.
Blue Apron was chosen as the best meal kit delivery service overall, as the top pick for most households.
Dinnerly was named the best value meal kit delivery service, starting at $5 per serving.
Home Chef was named the best meal kit delivery service for beginner cooks.
Sunbasket was named the best meal kit delivery service for vegetarian options.
Blue Apron lists a price per serving from $8, minimum meal size of 2 servings, maximum of 4 servings, minimum order of 2 meals per week, and 70+ weekly menu options.
Dinnerly lists a price per serving from $5, minimum order of 3 meals per week, and 100+ weekly menu options.
Blue Apron was made available à la carte on Amazon last year, according to the article.
Margaret Eby said Blue Apron provided the best packaging and ingredient organization of any meal kit she tested.
Dinnerly required the tester to supply her own vinegar, sugar and garlic, more than any other service tested.
Dinnerly's favorite dish for Eby was the garlic-soy pork udon noodles.
Kiki Aranita, a chef and award-nominated food writer, said: "I'm looking for ease, proper portioning and satisfaction from varying textures and flavors."
Aranita added: "I have a low tolerance for long instructions, especially when I'm hungry."
